_comment: I1 'A SETTING FOR A LADY', THE TALK TERMINAL (v0.16 #306). Takes the commission from the Lady in the stationer's, carries the true thing to Hedault's bench, and reports back for the terminal setting_commissioned + the locket + 25 gold. ALSO OWNS THE VISIBLE-LOCKED PIN: its fixture grants neither [Appraise Goods] nor [Detect Magic], so heirloom_bench's two skill arms render locked-but-shown -- dialogue.gd's _visible_options hides only PROGRESS-gated requires (accomplishment/board/delivery/once_per_waking), never a skill or item one. Its twin invrisil_setting_skill owns the selectable arm; a skill cannot be unlearned mid-run, so one script structurally cannot own both legs. Seed inert.

steps._comment: Title's default row is New Game -- down 1 to Continue, which loads the fixture-seeded manual slot.

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: This is the only shop on the street where a woman may sit for an hour and be assumed to be choosing ink.

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: I have been sitting in a paper shop for an hour. You are the first person to stop at this table. Nobody asks a woman in a paper shop what she is holding. I learned that young and have relied on it ever since, and I had set this afternoon aside for nobody asking at all.

steps._comment: Visible rows here are exactly two: 'What is it you're holding?' and 'Another time.' -- the three report arms are accomplishment-gated and therefore HIDDEN, not locked. The option's own effects emit BEFORE the node it goes to, in authored order (quest, then counter).

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: My mother's. The stone in it is glass. I have known since I was nineteen and I have never once said so out loud, and I am not going to begin by saying it to a jeweller who will write it on an order. This city is run from a house you cannot see from any street in it, by a woman who notices everything worth noticing. A glass stone is exactly the right size to stay beneath that notice. I intend to keep it there.

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: Because she wore it to every hard thing she ever did and it never once let her down. The stone was glass for all forty of those years. It did not matter then and I will not let it start mattering now. I want the setting held properly. The stone can stay glass.

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: There is an enchanter with a bench in the alleys who will not touch a piece until somebody in the transaction tells him the truth about it. He is right to insist and I cannot be the one who does it. Twenty five gold when it is set. Do not be charming at him. My house is down to two assets. The name is one. The other is the habit people have of not looking past it. Tell him the truth of the stone and keep the name out of his order book.

steps._comment: == HEDAULT'S BENCH. near_hedault's own approach cell: (0,7), bump north into his blocked (0,6). First interact is his talk pool, the second opens the shop graph. ==
#423: Hedault lives in enchanter_shop now. The teleport lands on the shop's own door cell (6,7) -- NOT beside him -- and this walks the floor to (2,4) before bumping north into his (2,3).

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: Appraisal is free to watch and expensive to interrupt.

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: State the item and keep your hands where I can see them. First I appraise. Then I correct, if correction is warranted, and I charge exactly what the work is worth.

steps._comment: Six visible rows: the four item/gold arms (all VISIBLE-LOCKED on this build), 'Just looking.', and the heirloom row LAST -- the door-reading arm is accomplishment-gated and hidden. Down 5. The node it opens carries THE PIN: the two skill arms locked, with their requirement strings, copied verbatim from this script's own events.jsonl.

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: Set it on the cloth. Do not hand it to me. I have looked at it twice already and I will not cut a mount until somebody in this transaction says the true thing out loud: that stone is glass, cut well, sold badly, and about forty years old. I will not cut a mount over a lie. It is half-drawn on the bench behind me, and it stays half-drawn until I hear it.

options.text: "She's known since she was nineteen. She wants the setting held, and the stone left as it is."
[Appraise Goods] Read it out with him, weight by weight.
[Detect Magic] Follow the ward-line to where it wants to sit.
"Somebody swapped it. Who buys a stone like that?"

steps._comment: Row 0 is the plain truth arm. Rows 1 and 2 are the two skill arms, which this fixture holds NEITHER skill for -- they render VISIBLE-LOCKED, which is this script's own pin (see the options assertion above).

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: Good. Then it goes on the order in those words and the price changes, downward, because glass takes less holding than a stone does. Glass wants a shallower seat and a thinner ward-line, which is fewer hours and less silver on my side of the cloth. The mount behind me can be finished this afternoon. I would rather be told than discover it at the bench.

steps._comment: == THE REPORT. Her pool is spent for this waking, so the interact opens the graph directly on the mid-quest variant. ==

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: You went, then. Sit down and tell me what he said. Every word, please. People have been giving me the polite half of things for forty years.

steps._comment: Two visible rows: the truth-kept report arm, then 'Another time.' -- the assist and recovery arms are gated on counters this route never banks.

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: Then it is done, and done in the open, which I did not expect and did not know I wanted. Here. My mother had a second piece, plain, honest, worth a tenth of the first and worn twice as often. I would rather it went to somebody who earned it. It has spent long enough in the box.

steps._comment: Effects-plus-end: DIALOGUE_ENDED fires synchronously BEFORE the effects apply, so wait the close first and the banks after.
steps.name: confirm
